en: Illustrated postcard showing a lively terrace restaurant beside a large building, filled with people sitting at tables under lanterns. A red sign on the wall advertises regular concerts. To the right, the scene opens to a panoramic view over a wide river with boats, tree‑covered banks, and distant mountains topped with small buildings or ruins. A flagpole with the black‑white‑red German Imperial flag stands prominently. Decorative lettering in German and handwritten text overlay part of the image.
